title: Father teaches him guitar-and-snare drum as a boy
summary: His father played guitar and bought him a snare drum at about nine; they played for money. After his father died he let drums go until the thirties.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons
